errors.message: Response error: No HSTS header is present on the response.

`http://google.com` (HTTP) should immediately redirect to `https://google.com` (HTTPS) before adding the www subdomain. Right now, the first redirect is to `http://www.google.com/`. The extra redirect is required to ensure that any browser which supports HSTS will record the HSTS entry for the top level domain, not just the subdomain.
